title_en: Provisions of the State Council on the Management of Seals of State Administrative Organs, Enterprises, Institutions, and Social Organizations

articles.content_en: 1. Seals of state administrative organs, enterprises, institutions, and social organizations shall be circular, with the national emblem or a five-pointed star engraved in the center.

2. The seal of the State Council shall be 6 cm in diameter, with the national emblem engraved in the center, and the name of the organ engraved outside the national emblem, running left to right in a circular pattern (Figure 1), and shall be made by the State Council itself.

3. The seals of the people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, and of the General Office of the State Council and the ministries and commissions of the State Council shall be 5 cm in diameter, with the national emblem engraved in the center, and the name of the organ engraved outside the national emblem, running left to right in a circular pattern (Figure 2), and shall be made and issued by the State Council.

4. For seals of organs directly under the State Council and administrative offices, those of units at the full ministerial level shall be 5 cm in diameter, and those of units at the deputy ministerial level shall be 4.5 cm in diameter, with the national emblem engraved in the center, and the name of the organ engraved outside the national emblem, running left to right in a circular pattern (Figure 3), and shall be made and issued by the State Council.

5. For seals of institutions directly under the State Council, those of units at the full ministerial level shall be 5 cm in diameter, and those of units at the deputy ministerial level shall be 4.5 cm in diameter. For units that are recognized by the state institution establishment administration department as having administrative functions, the national emblem shall be engraved in the center of the seal; for units without administrative functions, a five-pointed star shall be engraved in the center. The name of the unit shall be engraved outside the national emblem or five-pointed star, running left to right in a circular pattern (Figure 4), and shall be made and issued by the State Council.

6. The seals of the State Council's consultative coordination bodies and ad hoc bodies shall be 5 cm in diameter, with a five-pointed star engraved in the center, and the name of the organ engraved outside the five-pointed star, running left to right in a circular pattern (Figure 5), and shall be made and issued by the State Council.

7. The seals of state bureaus administered by the ministries and commissions of the State Council shall be 4.5 cm in diameter, with the national emblem engraved in the center, and the name of the organ engraved outside the national emblem, running left to right in a circular pattern (Figure 6), and shall be made and issued by the State Council.

8. The seals of the foreign affairs departments (bureaus) under the ministries and commissions of the State Council shall be 4.2 cm in diameter, with the national emblem engraved in the center, and the name of the organ engraved outside the national emblem, running left to right in a circular pattern (Figure 7), and shall be made and issued by the State Council.
The seals of internal bodies and subordinate institutions of the departments of the State Council, as well as units whose legal names are prefixed with 'People's Republic of China' or 'State,' shall be 4.2 cm in diameter, with the national emblem engraved in the center, and the name of the unit engraved outside the national emblem, running left to right in a circular pattern (Figure 8), and shall be made and issued by the State Council.

9. The seals of the people's governments of autonomous prefectures, cities, counties (including counties, autonomous counties, county-level cities, banners, autonomous banners, special zones, and forest districts, hereinafter the same), and of municipal districts shall be 4.5 cm in diameter, with the national emblem engraved in the center, and the name of the organ engraved outside the national emblem, running left to right in a circular pattern (Figure 9), and shall be made and issued by the people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, or municipalities directly under the Central Government.

10. The seals of administrative offices of prefectures (leagues) shall be 4.5 cm in diameter, with a five-pointed star engraved in the center, and the name of the organ engraved outside the five-pointed star, running left to right in a circular pattern (Figure 10), and shall be made and issued by the people's governments of provinces or autonomous regions.

11. The seals of the people's governments of townships (towns) shall be 4.2 cm in diameter, with a five-pointed star engraved in the center, and the name of the organ engraved outside the five-pointed star, running left to right in a circular pattern (Figure 11), and shall be made and issued by the people's governments at the county level.

12. The seals of embassies and consulates stationed abroad shall be 4.2 cm in diameter, with the national emblem engraved in the center, and the name of the organ engraved outside the national emblem, running left to right in a circular pattern (Figure 12), and shall be made and issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

13. The seals of internal bodies or units directly under state administrative organs shall not exceed 4.5 cm in diameter, with a five-pointed star engraved in the center, and the name of the unit engraved outside the five-pointed star, either running left to right in a circular pattern, or with the first part running left to right in a circular pattern and the latter part arranged horizontally from left to right (Figure 13). They shall be made and issued respectively by the departments of the State Council and state administrative organs at various local levels.

14. The seals of enterprises, institutions, and social organizations shall not exceed 4.5 cm in diameter, with a five-pointed star engraved in the center, and the name of the unit engraved outside the five-pointed star, running left to right in a circular pattern (Figure 14). The measures for making and issuing such seals shall be separately formulated by the Ministry of Public Security in conjunction with relevant departments.

15. The name engraved on the seals of state administrative organs, enterprises, institutions, and social organizations shall be the legal name. If the name is too long to be easily engraved, a standardized abbreviation may be used. The seals of administrative offices of prefectures (leagues) shall be prefixed with the name of the province (autonomous region). The seals of the people's governments of autonomous prefectures, cities, and counties shall not be prefixed with the name of the province (autonomous region, municipality directly under the Central Government). The seals of the people's governments of municipal districts shall be prefixed with the name of the city, and the seals of the people's governments of townships (towns) shall be prefixed with the name of the county-level administrative area.
16. The seals of the people's governments of areas implementing regional ethnic autonomy may concurrently display Chinese characters and the corresponding ethnic script.
17. The Chinese characters engraved on seals shall be simplified Chinese characters as promulgated by the State Council, in Song typeface.
18. The material of seals shall be determined by the issuing organ based on actual needs.

19. The overprint seals and seal impressions used by the people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, and by the ministries and commissions and organs directly under the State Council when printing documents, shall have specifications and patterns equivalent to the official seals, and shall be made and issued by the State Council.

20. The wax seals used for foreign affairs by the relevant ministries and commissions of the State Council shall be 4.2 cm in diameter, with the national emblem engraved in the center, and the name of the organ engraved outside the national emblem, running left to right in a circular pattern, and shall be made and issued by the State Council.

21. The steel seal of the State Council shall be 4.2 cm in diameter, with the national emblem engraved in the center, and the name of the organ engraved outside the national emblem, running left to right in a circular pattern, and shall be made by the State Council itself.
The specifications and patterns of steel seals used by local foreign affairs agencies and embassies and consulates abroad shall be formulated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
For other units that indeed need to use steel seals, the diameter of their steel seals shall not exceed 4.2 cm and shall not be less than 3.5 cm, with a five-pointed star engraved in the center, and the name of the unit engraved outside the five-pointed star, running left to right in a circular pattern. They shall be engraved after reporting to and obtaining approval from the organ that issues their seals.

22. Other special-purpose seals (including economic contract seals, financial seals, etc.) of state administrative organs, enterprises, institutions, and social organizations shall differ in name and pattern from the unit's official seal, and may be engraved after approval by the leadership of the unit.

23. The seal issuing organs shall standardize and strengthen the management of seal issuance, and strictly follow procedures and approval formalities. State administrative organs, enterprises, institutions, and social organizations that engrave seals shall go to the engraving units designated by the local public security organs for engraving.

24. If the seals of state administrative organs, enterprises, institutions, and social organizations are discontinued due to the dissolution of the unit, change of name, or replacement with a new seal, they shall be promptly delivered to the seal issuing organ for sealing up or destruction, or be handled in accordance with the provisions separately formulated by the Ministry of Public Security in conjunction with relevant departments.

25. State administrative organs, enterprises, institutions, and social organizations must establish and improve a seal management system, strengthen the management of seal usage, and strictly follow approval formalities. Without approval from the leadership of the unit, the unit's seal shall not be used without authorization.

26. Those who forge seals or use forged seals shall be investigated and punished in accordance with relevant state laws and regulations. If any forgery of seals or use of forged seals is discovered, it shall be promptly reported to the public security organ or the unit whose name is engraved on the seal. The specific measures for the social security management of seals shall be formulated by the Ministry of Public Security in conjunction with relevant departments.

27. If any previous provisions on seal management are inconsistent with these Provisions, these Provisions shall prevail.
